title: Exact LRN across campuses
steps: Submit two different people with the same 12-digit LRN in different campuses.
expected: Second application is duplicate_flag; no student identity is created.
actual: Cross-campus LRN duplicate returned duplicate_flag and null studentId.

title: Fuzzy name plus DOB
steps: Submit a small first-name spelling variation with the same surname and birth date.
expected: Suspected match is flagged.
actual: Small name variation plus same DOB returned duplicate_flag.

title: Different birthday
steps: Submit the same name with a different DOB and no matching LRN.
expected: Application remains submitted, without a false duplicate flag.
actual: Same name with a different DOB returned submitted.

title: Unrelated person
steps: Submit unrelated first/last names with the same DOB.
expected: Application remains submitted.
actual: Unrelated names sharing DOB returned submitted.

title: Empty IDs and self-exclusion
steps: Run the PR #6 fixture with empty identifiers and exclude its own application ID.
expected: Empty values do not match; application does not match itself.
actual: Six PR #6 fixture checks passed, including blank identifiers and self-exclusion.

title: Duplicate adjudication
steps: Open Duplicate Records and attempt the production case/resolve workflow.
expected: Side-by-side case review and adjudication should exist for the full feature.
result: BLOCKED: production screen is a placeholder and case API is absent; matching alone passes.
actual: production screen is a placeholder and case API is absent; matching alone passes.

title: Catalog mapping
steps: Choose a real campus, term, program group, track, specialization and voucher; submit.
expected: Numeric catalog IDs and valid matching track are persisted.
actual: Form-to-API catalog mapping passed and persisted numeric IDs.

title: Required fields and invalid input
steps: Submit invalid LRN, incompatible track, inaccessible campus or multiple primary guardians.
expected: Request rejected; no partial application/student writes.
actual: Invalid/scoped inputs rejected; partial-write assertions passed.

title: Multiple guardians
steps: Enter two guardians and a primary contact; create then review the application.
expected: Both contacts persist and are copied to the linked student.
actual: Two guardians persisted; primary-contact validation passed.

title: Queue filtering and persistence
steps: Create applicant, reload detail, apply campus filtering and exercise paged API results.
expected: Saved profile survives reload; scoped filters and pagination return the matching records.
actual: Reload persistence, campus filtering and paged API assertions passed.

title: Explicit registrar review
steps: Submit a new applicant, attempt confirmation, then explicitly review/pre-enlist.
expected: Submission alone creates no student or enrollment; review links one identity; concurrent review creates only one.
actual: Explicit review created/linked one student; concurrent review produced one success and one conflict.

title: Existing-student journey
steps: Submit continuing/returnee category and try to review/link it.
expected: Existing identity should be linked without duplicating the student for complete intake coverage.
result: BLOCKED: capture works; continuing/returnee review returns 409 pending existing-student linkage.
actual: capture works; continuing/returnee review returns 409 pending existing-student linkage.

title: Initial checklist
steps: Read checklist for an application with no document rows; read history.
expected: All catalog credentials appear Pending; reads do not manufacture audit entries.
actual: Read returned Pending catalog items without fabricated history.

title: Completeness rules
steps: Exercise submitted/missing/pending/invalid mandatory credentials and an optional credential.
expected: Complete/Incomplete/Pending are correct; optional credentials do not block completion.
actual: All mandatory summary states and optional-item exclusions passed.

title: Attributed immutable audit
steps: Update status and note; inspect old/new values and actor; try changing audit rows.
expected: Real actor/time and before/after values retained; audit modification rejected.
actual: Actor/before-after/history checks passed; audit mutations rejected.

title: No-op and stale writes
steps: Repeat an identical save, then save a stale version.
expected: No fake audit for no-op; stale edit gets 409 and cannot overwrite.
actual: No-op did not add history; stale writes conflicted.

title: Validation and access
steps: Use invalid code/status/notes, another campus and an unauthorized role; request paged history.
expected: Invalid writes rejected; no cross-campus or unrelated history leakage.
actual: Invalid/scoped/unrelated history access checks passed.

title: Concurrent first save
steps: Start two document writes with the same initial version.
expected: Exactly one succeeds and the other conflicts.
actual: Concurrent first writes produced one success and one conflict.

title: Live directory/dialog
steps: Open persisted applicant through requirements directory and deep link.
expected: Actual catalog/checklist loaded; no seeded mock states or fabricated history.
actual: Directory and deep-link dialog loaded persisted backend data.

title: Status and note persistence
steps: Set Missing with note, reload, then set Submitted.
expected: Saved status/notes survive reload and history contains the change.
actual: Status and notes survived reload; live history entry displayed.

title: Real two-tab conflict
steps: Load same checklist in two separately authenticated tabs; save A, then stale B.
expected: B shows conflict and retains its unsaved note; A is not overwritten.
actual: Second tab got a conflict and retained its unsaved note.

title: Follow-up contacts
steps: Open contact details before and after student creation.
expected: Actual applicant and guardian contacts displayed; no simulated message sent.
actual: Real student/guardian contacts displayed before/after linkage; no sending action simulated.

title: Plain text and separate drafts
steps: Save one document while another has a draft; render markup-like notes.
expected: Other draft remains; note is rendered as text.
coverage: enrollment.test.jsx: preserves another document draft; renders verification notes as plain text
actual: Independent drafts remained and markup-like notes rendered as text.

title: Filtering, keyboard and mobile
steps: Filter requirement status/program; dismiss checklist with Escape; reopen; use 390px viewport.
expected: Filters call server; dismissal/reopen works with persisted notes; no document overflow.
actual: Filter tests, Escape/reopen and 390px document-overflow checks passed.

title: Credential gate
steps: Try confirming with missing mandatory documents.
expected: Confirmation disabled/rejected and no enrollment inserted.
actual: Incomplete credentials kept confirmation disabled and API rejected premature confirmation.

title: Attendance gate
steps: Complete documents; use no attendance, Absent or Excused before Present.
expected: No/Absent/Excused do not satisfy the gate; Present does.
actual: No/Absent/Excused attendance did not satisfy the gate; Present enabled confirmation.

title: Dates and evidence retention
steps: Try future attendance and stale date version; remove last present after enrollment.
expected: Future/stale edit rejected; confirmed student retains present evidence.
actual: Future/stale date edits and loss of final Present evidence were rejected.

title: Explicit confirmation and reload
steps: Record Present, open confirmation dialog, confirm and reload.
expected: Enrolled status and attributed confirmation persist; verification alone does not enroll.
actual: Explicit confirmation persisted enrolled standing, staff attribution and reload state.

title: Concurrency and retries
steps: Confirm concurrently; retry with old/current version; promote provisional record.
expected: One enrollment only; stale version conflicts; current retry is safe; same-term duplicate rejected.
actual: Concurrent/retry/provisional/same-term checks passed without a second enrollment.

title: Other blockers and scope
steps: Try inactive/missing student, open duplicate case, under-review standing or another campus/role.
expected: Every blocker is enforced on server; no partial enrollment.
actual: Student/status/duplicate/campus/role blockers rejected without partial enrollment.

title: Create section in UI
steps: Create a scoped section with campus, term, strand, grade and capacity.
expected: Section persists with correct configuration and zero occupancy.
actual: UI created a matching section with capacity one.

title: Edit and stale conflict
steps: Edit room/capacity with current version, reload and retry old version.
expected: Current edit persists; stale update is rejected.
actual: UI room edit persisted; stale edit checks passed.

title: Validation and adviser scope
steps: Use zero capacity, invalid parent IDs or adviser without campus adviser grant.
expected: Invalid request is rejected without partial section.
actual: Invalid capacity/parent/adviser inputs rejected.

title: Fixed academic-term parent
steps: Attempt to change the section’s academic term after creation.
expected: Term change is rejected; the original parent is preserved.
actual: Academic term change was rejected.

title: Capacity lower bound and race
steps: Reduce below current occupancy; race capacity reduction against assignment.
expected: Capacity never falls below occupied seats.
actual: Capacity reduction/assignment race never allowed occupancy above capacity.

title: Delete safeguards
steps: Delete unused section, then attempt deleting a section with enrollment.
expected: Unused section deletes; referenced section remains with a conflict response.
actual: Unused deletion passed; UI/API refused referenced deletion and retained section.

title: Scoped directory and route filters
steps: Filter confirmed students by campus/program, district and transport route.
expected: Matching scoped students returned; unconfirmed applicants cannot be allocated.
actual: Scoped district/route filters passed; unconfirmed assignment was blocked.

title: Assign and persist
steps: Assign confirmed student to matching section and reload.
expected: Assignment retained and occupied/available counts updated.
actual: Assignment and occupied/available counts survived reload.

title: Compatibility and versions
steps: Try wrong campus/program/grade, missing grade or stale enrollment version.
expected: Invalid allocation rejected; original enrollment preserved.
actual: Wrong grade/program/campus, missing grade and stale versions rejected.

title: Full section UI and server
steps: Fill a one-seat section; load another confirmed student; force assignment through API.
expected: UI disables assignment; server returns 409; occupancy remains one.
actual: Full section disabled assignment; forced API call got 409 and occupancy stayed one.

title: Concurrent last seat
steps: Race two confirmed students for one available seat.
expected: Exactly one succeeds; one conflicts; no overbooking.
actual: Last-seat race produced one success/one conflict and one occupied seat.

title: Removal and academic history
steps: Remove ordinary assignment; try moving student with class memberships.
expected: Ordinary removal succeeds; academic membership blocks transfer to preserve grades.
actual: Ordinary removal worked; academic membership prevented reassignment.

title: Seven actual sign-ins
steps: Provision seven roles and sign in as each with chosen password.
expected: Every role authenticates and reaches an allowed landing screen.
actual: All seven roles provisioned and authenticated through real API/browser checks.

title: Session restoration
steps: Reload each role session after successful login.
expected: Session and correct role landing restored.
actual: Every role restored its session after reload.

title: Bad/inactive/revoked accounts
steps: Use bad password, deactivate account, reuse revoked token and activate using current version.
expected: Bad/inactive/revoked access rejected; valid reactivation enables new login.
actual: Bad/inactive/revoked access rejected; current-version activation enabled new login.

title: Role-safe return URL
steps: Sign in as each non-admin with a saved User Accounts URL; request admin APIs.
expected: Redirect goes to allowed landing; direct unauthorized API access rejected.
actual: Each role reached an allowed landing from a saved admin URL; unauthorized APIs stayed denied.

title: Provisioning controls
steps: Create accounts through admin UI/API; try non-admin, cross-campus, weak password and self-deactivation.
expected: Valid scoped creation works; invalid operations denied; hashes are not returned.
actual: Scoped provisioning/status/validation/self-protection and password-hiding checks passed.

title: Reviewer-accessible accounts
steps: Verify the role accounts exist in the actual team review environment after QA cleanup.
expected: Reviewer can access the intended preview environment using privately supplied credentials.
result: CONDITIONAL: this QA provisions disposable accounts only; target team/review database has not been inspected or provisioned.
actual: this QA provisions disposable accounts only; target team/review database has not been inspected or provisioned.
